def: properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow

occurrences.text: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
